is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports kdr-w (L995F) and kdr-e (L995S) mutations in An. gambiae s.s. (page 1, 8, 10).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotypic frequencies (ReS, ReRe, ReRw, RwRw, RwS, SS) for kdr loci in five districts (page 10).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Libreville, Gabon (page 1, 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original entomological survey conducted from December 2008 to January 2010 (page 2, 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for five specific districts: Alibandeng, Camp des Boys, Beauséjour, Sotega, and Akébé-Poteau (page 2, 3, 6).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers a one-year survey from December 2008 to January 2010 (page 2, 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary survey conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study surveyed malaria transmission and insecticide resistance markers in Anopheles gambiae s.l. in five districts of Libreville, Gabon, between December 2008 and January 2010. It reports kdr-w and kdr-e mutation frequencies in An. gambiae s.s. molecular form S.
